trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with health checks failing and an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was older).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback succeeded (`status: rolled_out`), and verification shows the service is now healthy (error rate 0.002) on v2.3.0 in all regions.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0002** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy"), which paged the on-call engineer. The first attempt timed out, so I retried and confirmed it was created.

Note: v2.3.1 remains the latest release but is unhealthy; the incident is open for follow-up on root cause before any re-deploy.
